purpose: paired block bootstrap of the SGMC pseudo-label signal: same 51 km blocks, same policy, no-pseudo baseline (data/evidence/block_holdout) vs pseudo run; the pseudo model NEVER saw the held-out blocks' pseudo pixels, so a gain here is generalisation of the SGMC-mapped fault style, not label leakage
reading: row 0 = baseline (no pseudo), row 1 = pseudo; prob_beats_reference is the paired P(pseudo > baseline) over 2000 block resamples on the fold's HELD-OUT blocks
shipping_note: no decision is made here: a pseudo-labelled ensemble ships only through the field-selection gate (docs/FIELD_SELECTION_RULE.md) as a new reblend.yml RUN_ID with measured R3
